name: Foixà (Spain)
description: Red field with a black lozenge at the centre bearing the white lion of the arms, between six yellow fleurs-de-lis, three at the hoist and three at the fly.
history: The flag was approved on 7 June 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4663 of 27 June 2006; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with a black square set on its point bearing the white lion of the arms at the centre and six yellow fleurs-de-lis arranged vertically, three at the hoist and three at the fly.
